questions.question: Three statements are made: A says, 'B is lying.' B says, 'C is lying.' C says, 'A and B are both lying.' If exactly one person is telling the truth, who is truthful?
questions.solution: If B is truthful, C is lying and A is also lying, giving exactly one truthful speaker.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A factory installed preventive maintenance software, after which unplanned machine downtime decreased. Which conclusion is most justified?
options: The software is proven to be the only cause
The decrease may be related to improved maintenance planning
questions.solution: The timing suggests a possible contribution, but it does not establish exclusive causation.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A meeting must include exactly three of four topics A, B, C and D. A cannot be together with C. B must be included if D is included. Which set is possible?
questions.solution: A,B,D satisfies the A-C restriction and includes B whenever D is present.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Is integer n positive? Statement I: n² = 9. Statement II: n is not equal to -3.
questions.solution: I gives n = 3 or -3. II excludes -3, so together n=3 and is positive.

questions.question: Statement: The department should add more public-service counters on peak days to reduce queues. Assumptions: I. Peak-day demand can create long queues. II. Additional counters can help handle the demand.
questions.solution: Both assumptions are necessary for the recommendation to make sense.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Four officers K, L, M and N have different ranks. K is senior to L. M is junior to N but senior to L. Who can be the most senior?
questions.solution: N is above M, and M is above L. K is above L but is not compared with N; therefore the statement set does not force N to be above K. Thus no option is necessarily most senior.
